title.zh: 白宫调整对加拿大汽车加征关税的产品范围
title.en: Modifying the Scope of Products of Canada Subject to the Additional Duties Imposed to Offset Canadian Discrimination Against the United States with Respect to Motor Vehicles

current_state.zh:
白宫发布公告，修改了根据2026年7月20日第11048号公告对加拿大产品加征额外关税的适用范围。这些关税旨在应对美方认定的加拿大对美国汽车实施的歧视性关税。

该行动延续了美国对加拿大汽车贸易做法的制裁措施，将影响供应链跨境的美加汽车制造商和零部件供应商。这也表明华盛顿愿意继续利用《关税法》第338条作为双边贸易争端中的施压工具。

该公告依据1930年《关税法》第338条（19 U.S.C. 1338）。第11048号公告认定，加拿大通过《2025年美国汽车附加税令》(SOR/2025-118) 仅对美国汽车征收关税，而给予其他国家更优惠的待遇。新公告进一步调整了受影响的加拿大产品清单。
current_state.en: The White House issued a proclamation modifying the scope of additional duties on Canadian motor vehicle products to address trade discrimination.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: The White House issued a proclamation modifying the scope of additional duties on Canadian motor vehicle products to address trade discrimination.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The White House issued a proclamation modifying the scope of additional duties on Canadian motor vehicle products to address trade discrimination.
updates.background_zh: 1930年《关税法》第338条授权总统对歧视美国商业的国家加征额外进口关税。2026年7月，由于加拿大的附加税令针对美国制造的汽车，第11048号公告对加拿大汽车加征了额外关税。最新公告对相关关税的产品范围作出调整，反映了两国在汽车贸易上的持续摩擦，尽管它们同属《美墨加协定》(USMCA)框架。
updates.background_en: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 allows the President to impose added duties on imports from countries that discriminate against US commerce. In July 2026, Proclamation 11048 applied additional duties to Canadian motor vehicles after Canada's Surtax Order targeted US-built vehicles. This latest proclamation adjusts the product scope of those duties, reflecting continued friction between the two neighbors over automotive trade despite their broader USMCA partnership.
updates.market_impact_zh: 由于该措施仅针对加拿大汽车产品，其对加密货币市场的直接影响有限。任何影响都将通过更广泛的贸易战风险情绪和全球市场风险偏好的变化间接传导。
updates.market_impact_en: Because the measure applies narrowly to Canadian motor-vehicle products, its direct effect on crypto markets is limited. Any impact would come indirectly through changes in broader trade-war risk sentiment and risk appetite across global markets.
